notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.0.8169
notes.notes:
New patch live since January 21st, 2021! Nothing major, but here's the details for those interested. 

Patch notes

Fixes achievements not always unlocking
Some players could not get the Paramount Paladin achievement to unlock. If this was the case for you, simply load your saved game. Achievement should unlock once the save icon pops up on the right of the screen.

The "Entry-Level CPU", "Mid-Range CPU" and "Cutting Edge CPU" achievements could be unlocked when earning a medal in any extra mode except the Challenge mode. New patch now include all extra modes. From now on, every new medal earned in the Challenge mode will count towards unlocking those achievements.

Fixes reconnection issues
Says it all.

---

Well that's it for now! Little reminder that this is the last week-end to order the Panzer Paladin vinyl soundtrack on Limited Run Games!

Cheers!
The Tribute Team

notes.title: Panzer Paladin gets a physical edition & vinyl release!
notes.notes:
You've been waiting for it, now it's here: the physical release of Panzer Paladin for Nintendo Switch by Limited Run Games. The time-limited preorder has already started and ends January 24th at 11:59 PM (ET). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917913/29fee4f04d120408a9fd743d8bd632540861de72.png

Also available, the Panzer Paladin Collectors' Limited Edition including the game on Switch with reversible cover, a complete 4-CD set including both Original and Classic 8-bit soundtracks, premium metal figures of Flame and Grit and a 18"x24" reversible poster. All of it housed in an outer box featuring unique cover art. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917913/90fab301f2e1d698383f71c728fb18aa8081c936.png


"But wait! There's more!"

We are also releasing a vinyl soundtrack for Panzer Paladin. It's a triple LP including the full Original soundtrack of the game and selected tracks from the Classic 8-bit soundtrack. All tracks - including the Classic 8-bit ones that were left out of the vinyl release - will be available digitally through an included download code. The cover is inspired from 60's jazz vinyl covers. Preorder window is the same as for the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917913/22bbfaeaae53f0cf856a7e8a2bf4600584984043.png

We also have trading cards!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917913/10ebe05cf2b294bdea6d2eed9d6a7ec16869e57c.png


F.A.Q. about the physical edition
Will the physical copy include the latest Challenge Core content update? 
Sure thing!

Will Panzer Paladin for Switch be released elsewhere? What about a European release?
Since the console is region-free, this Limited Run Games release is the only one planned for Switch. It is possible a standard edition of the game will be available at Best Buy (distributed by Limited Run Games again) but there is nothing confirmed as of now so it is better not to count on it. Collectors' Edition is only available through the Limited Run Games website. 

When will this release ship? 
Since it is a preorder, it is not expected to ship until 4-5 months after the preorder window closes in late January. 

Is this a Limited Run numbered release?
Panzer Paladin is not part of the Limited Run Games Collection and is not a numbered release. Limited Run is distributing Panzer Paladin on our behalf.


Now we wanted to take a moment to wish you a merry Christmas and happy holidays! And here's to 2021!

The Tribute Team

notes.title: Challenge Core: Content Update!
notes.notes:
New Content!
Good news! We're having a free content update for Panzer Paladin and it's available... today! It is already included in the base game. So if you purchase Panzer Paladin or already have it in your library, simply update the game and you will have access to all the Challenge Core content.

This new content update includes the following new features:

 New Challenge Mode with 11 rooms to truly test your skills
 Speedrun replay and leaderboard now available for all new rooms
 Brand New Classic 8-bit Soundtrack Option
 Blacksmith Weapons Storage Increased


Challenge Mode
The new Challenge Mode offers 11 hardcore rooms to train and improve your skills. Pick up 7 Tribute cores in each room!  Swiftly make your way through an array of pits, spikes, and enemies in record breaking time. Speedrun replay and leaderboards are also available for all new rooms. 

Classic 8-bit Soundtrack
Patrice Bourgeault is back at it with a demake of the original soundtrack. You can make your way through the game with a classic 8-bit complete soundtrack for an on-target retro experience. Choose the 8-bit soundtrack from the options menu before entering the game. Don’t worry, the Original soundtrack didn’t go anywhere, it is still available!

Pssst! You can also own the 8-bit soundtrack for a ridiculously low price right here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451790/Panzer_Paladin_Classic_8bit_Soundtrack

Blacksmith Weapons Storage Increased
You asked for it and now we have it! Benefit from a larger armory to store your custom weapons created with the Blacksmith. You can now store up to 12 custom weapons. That means more melee goodness for everyone! 

New Blacksmith Filter Option  [previewyoutube=RrNZn3UjCoA;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
Don’t feel like playing with custom made weapons? We’ve now made it possible for you to only play with the base weapons made by the devs. Turn off the Blacksmith filter in the options menu and only the 100 original weapons will drop in-game. 

Check out the trailer on YouTube! 

Patch

Along with the above extra content, we’ve also fixed and improved the base game. Here’s a list of additional changes from the most recent patch.
- Removed some buses in U.S.A. level that could be confused for platforms
- Fixed Recharge Station button prompt in German
- Fixed potential soft lock in Tanzania
- Changed Gauntlet Achievement text from "maxed out burden" to "high spirit burden"

We hope to get to see some of your challenge mode runs! Don't hesitate to share them with us on our Discord server or on the Steam community discussion board.

Take up the gauntlet! 

The Tribute Team

notes.title: First patch: Important fixes! (v1.0.0.6805)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks to your feedback and reports, we were able to quickly point out and fix some bugs in Panzer Paladin. We are happy to announce that the disappearing bug with Nian, China's weapon keeper, is fixed. We have also fixed that frustrating bug that happened to some of you that made you lose progress in the Inverted Tower when exiting the game to come back later. (You still shouldn't go back to the World Map in between stages.) 

Today's patch includes the following.

Changelist for version 1.0.0.6805
This patch will also come to Nintendo Switch sometime later in August.

Fixes
*Fixed Nian (China boss) disappearing
*Game Over no longer wipes Inverted Tower progression
*Fixed Tournament mode crash
*Fixed savegame play time reporting twice the actual time played
*Fixed curse reset. (ie. used to be able to stay in slowmo after death)
*Canada Story: Added a ceiling collision to prevent glitches in transition between part 3 and 4.
*Canada Remix: Added a ceiling collision to prevent glitches in transition between part 4 and 5.
*Japan Story and Remix: Changed dectection direction on some exploding blocks to prevent softlocks and cheap deaths with Flame.
*Japan, USA, Ravenous City, Catacombs (story and remix): Fixed missing collisions in easy mode.

Improvements
*Tweaked Catacombs level art

Reminder: Steam trading cards & badges are now also available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917913/ab18d1304c33d7b119aaa039815a1f1a056deb8d.gif
Soundtrack
It is now possible to listen to the soundtrack on all major music streaming services including Spotify and YouTube Music!

Own the full 37-track soundtrack of the game by getting it on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1375610/Panzer_Paladin_Soundtrack/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36917913/0c8af4991e0f6c020921c137103f4ae436af05cc.png

Thank you all for your support! And don't hesitate to let us know on the Steam forum or on our Discord if you have any question or if you spot something that should be fixed!

Cheers,
The Tribute Team
